parts.label: (a)
parts.official_mark_scheme_text:
B1: For $Q$, $R=0.1g\cos60^\circ=0.5$.
M1: $F=0.7(0.1g\cos60^\circ)=0.35$, using $F=\mu R$ where $R$ is a component of weight, not mass; allow sine/cosine mix.
M1: Complete resultant force for whole system: $0.2g\sin60^\circ-0.1g\sin60^\circ-F$; or separate equations $0.2g\sin60^\circ-T=0.2a$ and $T-0.1g\sin60^\circ-F=0.1a$ then eliminate $T$. Allow sign errors/sine-cosine mix, but all required terms and dimensional consistency; ignore RHS errors when judging this method.
A1: Since $3/2-0.35>0$, particles move. Require correct positive resultant (e.g. $0.8660...-0.35>0$ or positive 0.516... to at least 1 sf) and correct conclusion, no incorrect working. May calculate acceleration $(10\sqrt3-7)/6=1.72008...$ and conclude movement.
Printed total: 4.
